data.description:
## Symptom

On current `origin/main` (69cd2b9e15aa), this passes in the full suite but FAILS when run as
a narrow selection:

    pytest tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py::test_a_marker_in_a_new_gate_scripts_head_admits_it
    E   ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'scripts._mechanism_delta'

The failing import is inside `ratchet_head_lines()`:
`from scripts._mechanism_delta.markers import HEAD_LINES`. It needs the repo root on
sys.path, which in a narrow selection is not established.

## Bisected

    6b034b9f8224  PASS   (Make scanner-integration recipe POSIX-sh portable)
    9c7d78127696  FAIL   <- first bad commit: 'Revert scanner-integration Verified gate'
    cad66dd237cc  FAIL
    457d9a20bed9  FAIL
    a220bfafa7ae  FAIL
    69cd2b9e15aa  FAIL   (current main)

Reproduced on a clean detached worktree of unmodified origin/main, so this is not a
worktree or venv artifact. `import scripts` succeeds at BOTH refs when the repo root is
explicitly on sys.path, so the regression is in what puts it there during collection, not in
the package itself. The revert deleted scripts/install_review_scanners.py,
.github/workflows/_scanner-integration.yml and three infra/compose files, and touched the
Makefile; the mechanism connecting that to collection-time sys.path is the open question.

## Why CI is green anyway

The default suite runs the whole tree, where something else establishes the import before
this module needs it, so `Verified` passes and nothing surfaces. The failure appears only
when a contributor runs the module (or a small set of modules) on its own — which is exactly
what an agent does when told to 'run the three gates make lint does not cover'.

That makes this a sibling of bug 1035-bed7-c855-4732, in the OPPOSITE direction: 1035 is a
local green on a tree CI rejects; this is a local red on a tree CI accepts. Both erode the
same thing — whether a local result can be believed. A test that passes only by grace of
another test's import side effect is not a trustworthy oracle either way.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The narrow selection above passes on a clean checkout of main.
- [ ] The fix makes the import explicit (e.g. the module establishes the repo root on
      sys.path itself, as scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py already does for its own import)
      rather than relying on collection order.
- [ ] A regression test pins that the module passes when run ALONE, so the isolation
      property is enforced rather than incidental.

## Not claimed by this reporter

Found while rebasing change 2619 (bug 1035). Reported, not fixed: it is unrelated to that
change and fixing it there would have bloated an approved change and delayed both.
data.title: test_mechanism_delta fails in a narrow pytest selection on main: scripts._mechanism_delta unimportable
